subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the canonical pairing fix after removing the unrelated current-head snapshot and tightening malformed-JSON handling, or require a fresh narrow replacement PR?
rationale: The intended authorization-store fix is valuable, but the current head now carries unrelated security-sensitive automation/workflow changes and an incomplete parse-failure guard; a human should choose whether to repair this branch or restart from a clean branch.

options.title: Repair into a narrow pairing branch
options.body: Remove the broad 298281573d2c7a3a5d5cbbd65084a9a934cf5ac9 snapshot, throw on malformed allowFrom JSON under mutation pre-reads, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Require a fresh PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch as too dirty and ask for a new PR that contains only the pairing fix and focused tests/proof.

options.title: Accept the broad head intentionally
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers explicitly review and accept the unrelated workflow, automation, app, extension, and lockfile changes as part of this PR.

recommendation.title: Repair into a narrow pairing branch
recommendation.body: Remove the broad 298281573d2c7a3a5d5cbbd65084a9a934cf5ac9 snapshot, throw on malformed allowFrom JSON under mutation pre-reads, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.
